description: Find the official release notes and release-level impact for one supported exact SDK upgrade pair. Curated snapshot only. For a specified symbol, compare declarations separately with VersionProof using the same package and versions. See https://versionproof-beta.handy-drake-3041.chatgpt.site/integrations/github#agent-task for the paired Dependabot procedure.

from.description: The exact currently pinned release, such as 2.32.5. Do not use a range or latest.

package.description: Use the PyPI name shown in the coverage tool, such as requests. Do not enter a repository URL.

to.description: The exact proposed release, such as 2.33.0. Do not use a range or latest.

name: get_release_impact
